movedParts.name: clapper
movedParts.source: Concept ward-bell-v2-seed28101.png, seen about 15 degrees from above, shows the clapper's tip hanging below the lip's front edge by 16% of the bell's height (45 of 282 px) and no gap above it. In the first cook the bell is 2.26 m tall (lip z 3.64 m at radius 0.9 to 1.2 m) and the detached clapper hung at z 2.77 to 3.14 m, 0.50 m below the lip, so a gap showed under the front lip from that angle. Raised 0.2 m, its bottom sits 0.36 m (16% of the bell) below where the front lip edge projects onto the axis at 15 degrees (z 3.33 m), and its top is hidden behind the lip from every gameplay pitch (22 to 65 degrees).

materials.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active, supersampled) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh, then any declared colour repairs the recipe lists (matchBoxes, retint, facingBalance); tangent normals baked from the approved source mesh and whiteout-blended with relief derived from colour; AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness and metalness from recipe colour classes. Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.

tangentRepair.why: three.js normalizes vertex tangents in the vertex shader; a zero-length tangent becomes NaN and the bloom spreads it.

settings.POSITION: SHORT normalized about the bounding-box centre with one uniform scale; the scale and centre folded into the root node
settings.TEXCOORD: UNSIGNED_SHORT normalized where the UVs lie in [0, 1]

reorder.method: meshoptimizer reorderMesh: vertex-cache triangle order, then vertex-fetch vertex order
reorder.check: a permutation: every vertex keeps its exact attribute bytes, and the triangles are the same, with the same winding, in another order

geometryCompression.check: every view decoded again: attribute views byte-identical to the reordered data; triangle index views hold the same triangles in the same order and winding (only the first vertex may rotate)

derivedFrom.note: The exact ship-003-t-q output, reordered for locality and compressed by meshopt_glb.mjs (EXT_meshopt_compression, no lossy filters); the Blender cook was not re-run.
The exact ship-003-t output, quantized by quantize_prop_glb.py; the Blender cook was not re-run.
The exact ship-003 output, tangents checked and degenerate ones repaired by repair_tangents.py; the Blender cook was not re-run.

cook.scriptsNote: SHA-256 of each script with LF line endings, equal to its copy in scripts/models/pipeline.
cook.verification: tests/landmark-models.test.ts checks one static mesh and material within the triangle budget, normals, tangents and WebP maps, and that every vertex of every placement stays inside its location's authoritative 2.8 m circular building blocker and above the ground; tests/models.test.ts checks that every normal and tangent is a finite unit vector; tests/models-browser.test.ts decodes its maps and tests/props-browser.test.ts renders it at its locations on the shader programs warmed at load.

limitations: Single-view TRELLIS reconstruction from one approved concept: the far side, back and underside are TRELLIS's invention, with no rear-view painting projected onto them.
Roughness, metalness and ambient occlusion are derived from colour classes and Cycles bakes, not measured PBR or hand-painted masks.
Re-cooking is not guaranteed to be byte-reproducible: MikkTSpace tangents can round differently on a few vertices.

The bell's interior, the roof's underside and the frame's back are TRELLIS's invention; the hanging rod is thin and soft, and the shingles and stone coursing are painted into the albedo rather than modelled.

TRELLIS reconstructed the clapper as a detached piece 0.50 m below the lip; a declared repair raises it 0.2 m so it hangs below the lip as in the concept. It is still a separate piece with no clapper rod inside the bell.
Bronze, timber, moss and stone colour classes cover 91% of the surface; the remaining 9% takes the base roughness 0.86.

Placed at 0.98 of the 2.8 m building reach, the frame stands 7.8 m on a 5.1 x 2.3 m footprint at every building: lower than the procedural frame at the Bell Foundry (about 14 to 18 m on its 13, 15 and 17 m buildings) and about as tall as at the Reed Chapel (8.5 m on 8 m buildings). The building blockers are unchanged.
